note: The query each page is written for. scripts/check-keywords.py asserts the query's HEAD TERM appears in four places: title, h1, meta description and the opening paragraph, and that no two pages claim the same term. Review a target before trusting a pass on it, because the seed assumes the title states the subject and that assumption is the thing worth checking.
